messages:
Marnie (Content Lead): Hey team — uploaded a new draft of the product launch blog (short + punchy hero, bench callout, CTAs). Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/launch-draft-2024-xx

Julio (Growth): Nice rhythm. Two asks: (1) split CTAs into Start free trial vs Request enterprise demo; (2) add hidden HubSpot fields for ARR band + primary_use_case so SDRs can triage.

Tara (Design): Fig2 missing alt text — accessibility flag. Recommend alt: 'Median latency vs throughput across seq lengths'. Also propose a compact benchmark card under the hero so metric is visible on mobile.

Ibrahim (Sales Ops): Routing notes: demo form -> Sales Queue Prime; trial form -> auto-provision trial. Hidden fields: arr_band, company_size, region. SLA: enterprise leads must be touched within 1 business day. I'll paste form IDs in the shared sheet.

Priya (Legal): Quick flag: wording "50% lower per-token cost than managed alternatives" is risky without source. Please soften to "lower per-token costs observed in our tests" and add a footnote pointing to the internal cost appendix. Also confirm any customer quotes have written permission.

Marnie (Content Lead): Good catches. Will soften cost language to the suggestion and add the footnote. Also moving the benchmark card above the fold and compressing the hero to a single sentence.

DevRel Bot: Suggest adding a tiny reproducer in the appendix with exact hardware and run command. Example: `python run_bench.py --model redwood-7b --batch 16 --seq 512 --runs 5` plus a link to the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-examples

Julio (Growth): Webinar teaser under the CTAs please (one line + link). Proposed: 'Live launch webinar May 28 — benchmark deep-dive + live Q&A. Register: https://events.redwood.ai/may28'

Ibrahim (Sales Ops): HubSpot embed example (paste into blog):
```
const hubspot = {
  formId: "form_trial_2024" || "form_demo_ent_2024",
  hiddenFields: { utm_campaign: "summer_launch", arr_band: "${arr_band}", primary_use_case: "${use_case}", region: "${region}" }
};
```

Priya (Legal): Also make sure any comparative phrasing avoids naming competitors unless we add source links. I'll review the footnote and the quote approvals.

Tara (Design): I'll add the alt text, mobile benchmark card, and a small social SVG after copy lock.

publish-bot: Checklist update: awaiting signoffs from Legal and Sales Ops to enable enterprise routing. Target publish tentative: 2024-05-30T09:00:00-07:00 (PT). Final checklist will run 24h prior.

Marnie (Content Lead): I'll push an updated draft in ~45m (compress hero, soften claim, add footnote, benchmark card above fold, HubSpot snippet included). If no objections by EOD tomorrow, schedule publish for the tentative date. Thanks all.

Julio (Growth): LGTM pending the HubSpot IDs and webinar link. :thumbsup:

Ibrahim (Sales Ops): I'll validate routing and post the form IDs before EOD.

Priya (Legal): I'll try to review the footnote + quote approvals today.

DevRel Bot: Reminder set: include reproducer + raw run logs in the appendix for transparency.

Marnie (Content Lead): Closing thread after I post the updated draft. Thanks!
